_about: Edits to the agreed grouping (group_run1/2.json have identical partitions; they differ only in the wording of ids and names). Each edit says why.

east-usk: The lists' 'Usk L.H.': East Usk lighthouse was built in 1893, so in 1879-87 the Usk light is West Usk (run 2's reading).
rotten-island: Both runs: the lists' 'Killybegs' is the light at the harbour entrance.

allonby: Printed 'Allonby, L.H.' once (1881, no. 121) with C. Donald Thompson, who in 1887 is a private observer at Seaton-Carew; checked against Findlay below.
heligoland: Gätke's island station: the observer was not a light-keeper.
